coverage.name: Bent County
limitations: Checked 2026-10-10: the Bent County Clerk & Recorder page now links a '2026 General Election Sample Ballot' (https://www.bentcounty.net/government/docs/Bent%2011032026%20Sample%20Ballot.pdf, posted 2026-10-07). It is a scanned image (2 pages, no searchable text), so its contents cannot be confirmed from its text. Because this page treats a scanned ballot as unreadable, this row is source_unreadable, not none_found; a ballot with searchable text or a TABOR notice is needed to close it. No TABOR notice or list/IGA of participating political subdivisions is posted on bentcounty.net (clerk page, notices page and document center re-read).

bentcounty.colorado.gov (described in search results as the county's new site 'under construction') could not be opened; bentcounty.gov and www.bentcounty.gov refused the connection; no archived copy could be opened. These sites could not be checked.

Commissioners' minutes posted for 2026 (Jan 8 through Jul 9, 2026; 16 PDFs) were read: no resolution referring a county ballot question and no coordinated-election IGA appear in them. Minutes after Jul 9, 2026 (the period when referrals are normally certified) were not posted as of 2026-09-26. Rechecked 2026-10-10: the posted minutes still end at Jul 9, 2026.
The Colorado Health Foundation tracker could not be opened and was not used.

coverage.name: Las Animas (city)
limitations: Checked 2026-10-10: the Bent County Clerk & Recorder page now links a '2026 General Election Sample Ballot' (https://www.bentcounty.net/government/docs/Bent%2011032026%20Sample%20Ballot.pdf, posted 2026-10-07). It is a scanned image (2 pages, no searchable text), so its contents cannot be confirmed from its text. Because this page treats a scanned ballot as unreadable, this row is source_unreadable, not none_found; a ballot with searchable text or a TABOR notice is needed to close it. Bent County has also not posted a list/IGA of participating political subdivisions, so participation could not be determined from an official list.

The City's own site (cityoflasanimasco.gov; the older cityoflasanimas.colorado.gov could not be opened) has no election page and no 2026 election notice. Its public-notices page shows the city's regular municipal election was held in November 2025 (nomination petitions due Aug 25, 2025).

Regular City Council agendas for Jun 9, Jul 14, Aug 11 and Sep 8, 2026 were read (TownCloud agenda pages): none lists a resolution or ordinance referring a question to the Nov 3, 2026 ballot. Agenda/minutes PDF downloads for Jun–Sep 2026 redirected to the TownCloud homepage and could not be retrieved; only the HTML agenda pages were read.

Reviewed and excluded (council actions, not ballot measures): Ordinance 754 creating a code section on accessory dwelling units and tiny homes as ADUs (first reading Jul 14, second reading Sep 8, 2026); Resolution 32-26 setting a goal for affordable housing (Jul 14, 2026).

Rechecked 2026-10-10: the City's public-notices page and TownCloud agenda list were re-read. The October 13, 2026 Regular Council Meeting agenda (TownCloud agenda 312) lists Ordinance 757 (gun club lease) and Resolutions 44-26 to 46-26 (weed abatement), with no ballot referral; the city still has no election page.
